bio: The Atlantic Ocean provides a stunning backdrop for your afternoon tea at the Polurrian Bay. Perched atop the cliffs of the Cornish coastline, the Polurrian Bay prides itself on comfortable and elegant surroundings and heartfelt service from its staff. Alongside a terrace overlooking Mounts Bay, you can sink into the lounge sofas or hide out in the snug, or enjoy the spectacular sea view from the Vista section of the restaurant. You are welcome to borrow a book from the bookcases or a board game while you enjoy your afternoon tea at the hotel.
